Name: Fruit Bouquets Choco-Berry Birthday Cake by 1-800 Flowers
Natural: Make it the sweetest birthday celebration ever with this truly original strawberry arrangement! Both charming and delicious, it's crafted by designer Vivian of 1-800-Flowers | Conroy's in Costa Mesa, California in the shape of a birthday cake, featuring both plain strawberries, layers of berries covered with chocolaty confection and sprinkles and of course, candles.
